Elena: i'll be there, bringing extra napkins (very important)

Ken: doing it now -> https://files.redwood/clip-duck (uploading)
allhands-bot: Reminder: feedback survey live until EOD Friday. 3 minutes to help us improve! :sparkles:

Marta: love this energy. see y'all there :wave:
